tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal zhwa lu ba'i chos skyong spyi bstod zhal snga nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// dza yan tu/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rgyal sras gnod sbyin dbang por sku sprul pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung yongs kyi ded dpon che/ /rgyal chen ngal bsos po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag po 'jigs rung mthing nag 'bar ba'i sku/ /drag shul las mdzad klu dang srin po'i gtso/ /drag gtum pho nya spro zhing gdug can 'joms/ /drag byed rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po beng dmar srin po'i gzugs/ /dpal ldan lha mo las mkhan pho nyar bcas/ /dpal ldan thub pa'i bstan srung mthu bo che/ /dpal chen srung ma'i ded dpon de la 'dud/ /rab 'jigs gshin rje'i rgyal po dam can che/ /rab rgod ma he khros pa'i zhal dmar gdangs/ /rab gtum yum mchog 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/ /rab sdang dgra bo'i shan pa khyod la bstod/ /ma mo'i gtso mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /ma rungs 'dul 'gyur smug nag srin mo'i gzugs/ /ma ltar brtse bas bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong / /ma cig dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /rdo rje ma mo rma bya'i sgro thul can/ /rdo rje ral gri mda' dar ne'u le thogs/ /rdo rje 'dzin skyong bstan pa'i gnyer kha mo/ /rdo rje ri phug ma la bstod par bgyi/ /de ltar dpal ldan zhwa lu gser khang gi /chos grwa gtsug lag khang chen skyong ba yi/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs/ /dran g.yog mngags pa pho nyar bcas pa rnams/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dam rdzas gtor chen phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rten dang spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon gang ba/ /'bul lo mchod do dges shing rol bar mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa padma badzra dang / /di paṃ kā ra mi trā dzo ki'i zhabs/ /lo ston rdo rje dbang phyugs lce btsun rje/

/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig dgongs/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dmag dpung cher bskyed de/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis gsol ba btab pa yi/ /phrin las da lta nyid du sgrub par mdzod/ /spyi sgos bstan pa rin chen khyod kyis srungs/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe phrin las khyod kyis spel/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'khor bcas khyod kyis skyongs/ /bstan dgra dam nyams gdug can zhing 'di sgrol/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /ma phaṃ ma thogs mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bskyed/ /mā ra mā ra'i las la rings par chos/ /ma rabs ma rungs dgra bo da lta sgrol/ /zhes pa 'di yang zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa dam can dges pa'i rnal 'byor gyis phrin las zhu phyir 'phral du thogs med du bris nas mgon khang du phul ba siddhi ku ru sa ma ya// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dpal zhwa lu ba'i chos skyong spyi bstod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
